commit.subject: LU-20661 ptlrpc: Do not lower CPU latency for noreply RPCs
commit.message:
LU-20661 ptlrpc: Do not lower CPU latency for noreply RPCs

A noreply RPC has no reply to wake a thread up for, so keeping
the CPUs out of their deep idle states only costs power.
